nppes-new-providers-feed.title: New NPI Providers Feed (CMS NPPES weekly files)
limits: Weekly source: CMS publishes one file per week, about 1 to 2 days after the week ends. Only the two latest weeks exist, so schedule at least every 2 weeks.
A new NPI is an ID, not a licence, credential, Medicare enrolment or proof that a practice opened.
Individuals' street address and phone are off by default; no e-mail addresses exist in the source.

us-building-permits-feed.title: US Building Permits Feed (San Francisco, Austin, New Orleans)
limits: Three cities only: San Francisco, Austin and New Orleans (sources with an explicit public-domain or CC0 licence).
Not real time: permits usually appear 1 to 3 days after issue.
No owner, applicant or personal contractor names, no phones, no e-mails. Declared values are self-reported.

uk-public-tenders-feed.title: UK Public Tenders Feed (Find a Tender + Contracts Finder)
limits: Find a Tender and Contracts Finder only; notices only on Public Contracts Scotland, Sell2Wales or eTendersNI are not included.
About a third of notices have no value; values are as published, currencies are not converted.
No contact officer names, e-mails or phones. Tender documents are not downloaded.

tech-stack-detector.title: Tech Stack Detector (CMS, Shopify/WooCommerce, hosting, analytics, with evidence)
limits: Checks the websites you give it; it does not find new companies or build lead lists.
Unknown means not detected, never not used: tools loaded after consent, at checkout or by inline loaders can be missed.
Blocked, robots.txt-skipped and failed websites are returned with the reason and are free; no bypass is attempted.
